question: There are so many Re:Zero goods, but is there a particular piece of Re:Zero merchandise that you especially like?
answer:
Figures.

At first, I accepted all the merchandise I was given, but before long it looked like it was going to take over my entire room.

So I thought, “This is impossible.” Then I figured, “I'd like to have just the figures,” and “There probably won't be that many figures,” and “They won't release scale figures one after another that quickly.” So I asked for those...

And now there are about a hundred Rems in my house. Rem is terrifying.

Even so, I display as many of the figures as I can, and one of my particular favorites is a figure where Emilia, Ram, and Rem are idols, with Puck as their otaku captain.

I keep it in a case on top of my TV, and I really like it.

There are also some beautiful figures of Emilia and Rem in elegant dresses, sort of like they're skating on ice, and I have those displayed nicely as well.

Figures are great because they let you put the characters in outfits you can't make them wear in the main story.
